name: identify
description: identify.file: What a file is: format, format families and MIME type, from its first 256 KiB and its name. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.

name: inventory
description: inventory.native: One-call inventory of a native binary: per architecture slice, its kind, interpreter, own name (soname, DLL name or install name), linked libraries, exported and imported symbols, and language markers. Pass operation and its arguments; see session describe for one operation's schema.
